==> /etc/mysql/conf.d/zz-falak.cnf (-rw-r--r--)
# Rendered by falak-db at every container start: do not edit, changes are lost.
# Memory limit: 512 MiB

[mysqld]
port = 3306
socket = /var/run/mysqld/mysqld.sock
max_connections = 151
skip_name_resolve = ON
character_set_server = utf8mb4

innodb_buffer_pool_size = 281M
innodb_buffer_pool_instances = 1
innodb_buffer_pool_chunk_size = 281M
performance_schema = OFF

# Point-in-time recovery: binlogs are rotated and spooled every 60 s; the agent ships the spool.
server_id = 1
log_bin = binlog
binlog_format = ROW
binlog_row_image = FULL
sync_binlog = 1
innodb_flush_log_at_trx_commit = 1
binlog_expire_logs_seconds = 604800
gtid_mode = ON
enforce_gtid_consistency = ON

ssl_cert = /etc/falak/db/tls/server.crt
ssl_key = /etc/falak/db/tls/server.key
ssl_ca = /etc/falak/db/tls/ca.crt
tls_version = TLSv1.2,TLSv1.3

slow_query_log = ON
slow_query_log_file = /var/log/falak-db/slow.log
long_query_time = 1.000
==> tuning
innodb_buffer_pool_size = 281M
